title: ervum paucifolium
intro: Ervum paucifolium, commonly known as Trifolium pauciflorum or few-flowered clover, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Ervum paucifolium include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of Ervum paucifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
